claims.claim: We also deal in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not depicted or contradicted by the three photos; no way to confirm scope of seller's inventory remotely.

risks.risk: Make, model, and engine displacement/type unknown (critical for any price lookup)
risks.proof: Close-up of engine block casting number, ECU label, or any VIN/part-number sticker
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; treated as unidentified parts lot

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may be damaged internally
risks.proof: Video/audio clip of engine being started and running, or compression test readout

risks.risk: Completeness unclear (ECU, wiring harness, sensors, turbo)
risks.proof: Full 360° photos including wiring harness connectors and sensor ports

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history and reason for removal (accident vs swap) unknown
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or service record

risks.risk: Transmission may or may not be included in sale
risks.proof: Seller's written confirmation plus photo showing transmission still attached at sale

risks.risk: Strut assemblies' compatibility and condition unverified
risks.proof: Close-up of strut mounting brackets and any wear/rust at the mount points

risks.risk: Watermark 'Porsche Global Autos' may suggest branding not matching actual part origin
risks.proof: Clear shot of any manufacturer logo/casting mark on the engine block itself
risks.if_unproven: ignored as marketing name, not treated as brand confirmation

proof_requests: Clear photo of engine block casting/part number or ECU label showing make and model
Video of engine starting and idling
Photo of wiring harness and sensor completeness
Written confirmation on whether transmission and struts are included at the stated price
Any documentation on donor vehicle (mileage, accident history)
response.reason: The witness could not read any make, model, or engine identifier, and pricing used car engines requires knowing at least the vehicle type/displacement; without that, even a worst-case price cannot be set.
